meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你排查容器化 agent 的问题：读主机与安装日志、用查询脚本查看会话数据库（inbound.db/outbound.db）、检查挂载与心跳状态，并针对常见故障给出修复步骤。
howto.when: 当容器失败或退出、消息没有回复、出现认证问题（如 401 或网关不可达），或你想弄清容器系统与消息流转时触发。

say.text: 容器不回复了，帮我查日志和会话数据库
看看 inbound.db 最近的 messages_in，消息到容器了吗
重启这个 agent group 的容器并重建镜像

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you debug containerized agents: it reads host and setup logs, queries session DBs (inbound.db/outbound.db), checks mounts and heartbeat state, and gives fix steps for common issues.
howto.when_en: Use when things aren't working: a container fails or exits with no reply, authentication problems appear (e.g. 401 or unreachable gateway), or you want to understand the container system and message flow.

say_en.text: The container stopped replying, check the logs and session DBs
Look at the latest messages_in in inbound.db, did it arrive?
Restart this agent group's container and rebuild the image
